title: Clothing Donation Platform
raw_input: Build a clothing donation platform with HTML, CSS, and JS
deficiencies: Missing database and state persistence strategy
No user roles or authorization defined (Donor vs Charity Admin)
Undefined clothing category taxonomy and donation status workflow

objective.title: Community Clothing Donation Platform
objective.primary_goal: Enable community members to catalog, schedule, and track clothing donations to certified local charities.

technical_stack.styling_engine: Vanilla CSS Custom Properties (Dark / Light Theme)

functional_requirements.description: Multi-step form allowing donors to capture item type, condition, photo upload, and drop-off vs pick-up preference.
Admin dashboard to review submitted donations, change status (Pending -> Accepted -> Distributed), and generate receipts.
Live statistical counter displaying total kilograms of clothing diverted from landfills and families supported.

security: No raw eval or innerHTML injection

acceptance_criteria: Donor can complete a 3-step clothing submission and receive a unique Tracking ID.
Submitted donation immediately reflects in the Charity Admin view across browser tabs.
All user actions persist cleanly across page reloads using IndexedDB.

You are an autonomous software engineering agent executing Phase-by-Phase implementation of the Community Clothing Donation Platform.

Step 4: Implement client/js/db.js wrapping IndexedDB with Promise-based CRUD.

Step 6: Ensure zero console errors and full keyboard navigation.
</execution_protocol>
